about: src/lib/catalog_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (the backend and the POS core price a line with madar-catalog; features/public-ordering/pricing.test.ts runs the storefront's copy of unit_price/price_options against it). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
